title: John Bible Quiz - Chapter 19
description: Ten questions on John 19: the crown of thorns, the title on the cross, and the burial in the garden tomb.

questions.text: What did the soldiers put on Jesus after Pilate had him flogged?
questions.explanation: The soldiers twisted thorns into a crown and put it on his head, and dressed him in a purple garment.

answers.text: A white robe and a reed in his hand
A soldier's helmet and a spear
A crown of thorns and a purple garment

questions.text: On what ground did the Jews say Jesus ought to die?
questions.explanation: They answered that they have a law, and by their law he ought to die, because he made himself the Son of God.

answers.text: Because he made himself the Son of God

questions.text: What did Jesus answer Pilate about his power?
questions.explanation: Jesus answered that Pilate would have no power at all against him unless it were given to him from above.

answers.text: He had no power over anyone
His power was given to him from above
Caesar had given him all power
The chief priests held the power

questions.text: What did the chief priests answer when Pilate asked, "Shall I crucify your King?"
questions.explanation: The chief priests answered, "We have no king but Caesar!"

answers.text: We have no king but Caesar!
Write that he said it himself

questions.text: What did Pilate write on the title that he put on the cross?
questions.explanation: Pilate wrote a title and put it on the cross: "JESUS OF NAZARETH, THE KING OF THE JEWS."

answers.text: Jesus of Nazareth, the Son of God
Jesus of Nazareth, King of Israel
Jesus of Nazareth, the King of the Jews

questions.text: In which languages was the title written?
questions.explanation: Many of the Jews read the title, for it was written in Hebrew, in Latin, and in Greek.

questions.text: What did the soldiers decide to do with Jesus' coat?
questions.explanation: Because the coat was without seam, woven from the top throughout, they decided not to tear it but to cast lots for it.

answers.text: They gave it to his mother
They left it at the tomb

questions.text: What did Jesus say when he had received the vinegar?
questions.explanation: When he had received the vinegar, he said, "It is finished," bowed his head, and gave up his spirit.

questions.text: What did one of the soldiers do instead of breaking Jesus' legs?
questions.explanation: Seeing that he was already dead, they did not break his legs, but one of the soldiers pierced his side with a spear, and blood and water came out.

answers.text: He covered him with a cloth
He pierced his side with a spear

questions.text: Who came bringing a mixture of myrrh and aloes?
questions.explanation: Nicodemus, who at first came to Jesus by night, came bringing a mixture of myrrh and aloes.
